caption: This is what I do 5 minutes before sleep every night #usahealth #wellness #wellnessjourney #selflove #mentalhealth
transcript: The last five minutes of your day before you sleep are the most important five minutes you have. For the next eight hours, you will sink into your subconscious mind. You will rest there. You will marinate there. And in that quiet, my friend, you have only two paths. You can carry in everything that disappointed you today. The things that didn't work. The things that hurt. Or, you can plant something else instead. I am well. I am healthy. I am content. I am peaceful. Whatever you place there in those last five minutes is what your mind will tend to while you sleep. And when you wake, the world begins offering you back exactly what you planted the night before. So tonight, choose gently what you carry in.
